d: Aviation giants Boeing and Qantas announce mass layoffs. Qantas to fire 850 people due to AI overhaul. Qantas jobs to move to Accenture India. Boeing to fire 5% of commercial airplane workforce, and job cuts to begin in December. Firstpost looks at the latest crisis impacting the global aviation sector. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the reasons for the firings at Qantas and Boeing. HKS also looks at the impact of Artificial Intelligence on the aviation sector, and how they are leading to the layoffs.
